Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the search results for "Once Upon a Time" on MTGGoldfish. The search results explicitly listed two different cards: "Once Upon a Time, The List" and "Once Upon a Time-extended". The agent (or the orchestrator interpreting its action) selected the wrong card ("The List") instead of the actual banned card ("Once Upon a Time-extended"). This led to retrieving incorrect price data for a non-banned card, which ultimately resulted in the wrong final answer ("Once Upon a Time" instead of "Oko, Thief of Crowns" or another correctly identified card). Additionally, the agent never successfully gathered data for "Veil of Summer" before the process terminated, further compromising the accuracy of the comparison.
